questions: Is the bucket lowered once per well per trip, or can a single lowering of a bucket extract water from multiple wells simultaneously?
If a well has water units not divisible by capacity, does the bucket need to be lowered for the partial load, and is that counted as one lowering?
Can water be extracted from multiple wells in a single lowering if the bucket has remaining capacity after the first well?
Does the bucket need to be lowered even if it is empty (e.g., to check a well with no water)?
Is the bucket lowered once per trip regardless of how many units it actually extracts (up to capacity), or is each unit extraction a separate lowering?
Are all wells independent, or does extracting from one well affect the water distribution in others?
If capacity is greater than the total water in a well, does lowering the bucket once count even if it doesn't fill completely?
Must the bucket be lowered sequentially per well, or can lowerings be interleaved across wells?
